title: Closed Quote Without Matching Open Quote
message: A space is causing a quote mark to be interpreted as a quotation close.

notes.message: No opening quote was found before this mark. If you meant an apostrophe, escape it with a backslash.
notes.label: quote-start

cases.name: simple
cases.description: A quote mark with whitespace on both sides. (A `'` directly after a word, `a' b.`, is an apostrophe since GH #943 and no longer an error.)
